answer: Each agent must post a bond that is forfeited if its actions fail a challenge chosen after the bond is locked. The challenge can require a costly, publicly verifiable task, so an attacker cannot cheaply multiply identities and collect rewards with copied behavior. A violet account might pass once, but a cluster must fund separate bonds and spend compute on each delta challenge; an onyx reputation then grows only through successful rounds. This raises the cost of sybils without assuming identity is scarce.
